Creative Direction & Visual Design

Translate a creative idea into a visual language that stays consistent across a project.

Beginner → developing → advanced

What you can explore

  • Explore concept development, research, moodboards, storytelling and audience.
  • Work with typography, colour, composition, artwork and identity systems.
  • Develop a coordinated release, event or artist campaign across print and digital formats.

Put it into practice

Work towards a considered visual project and learn how to brief, present and refine creative work.

A pathway around your level

Tell us your experience, equipment and goals so we can discuss a suitable starting point. These are planned learning pathways; dates, duration, delivery format, course fees and availability will be confirmed before enrolment.
